label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 173 ]

blocks.text: Different groups develop ideas in different ways. In successful groups, individuals are encouraged to produce imaginative and original ideas and share them with others. In unsuccessful groups, individual members are not encouraged to do so. Instead, they are always asked to do groupthinking. In the beginning, there are no differences in the abilities and qualities among the members of these two kinds of groups. However, in the end, the groups which encourage individual members to think creatively will prosper, whereas those which do not will fail. Therefore, group leaders must learn this lesson and put it into practice in order to achieve productive and positive results.

readingSentences.english: Physical fitness is an ongoing journey rather than a temporary destination.
readingSentences.korean: 신체 건강은 일시적인 목적지가 아니라 평생에 걸친 지속적인 여정이다.

readingSentences.english: Short-term extreme diets often fail and lead to fatigue.
readingSentences.korean: 단기적인 극단적 다이어트는 대개 실패로 끝나며 피로를 유발한다.

readingSentences.english: Consistent moderate exercise combined with wholesome meals produces lasting vitality.
readingSentences.korean: 유익한 식사와 결합된 꾸준하고 적당한 운동이 지속 가능한 활력을 낳는다.

readingSentences.english: Small sustainable habits build a resilient body over decades.
readingSentences.korean: 지속 가능한 작은 습관들이 수십 년에 걸쳐 강인한 신체를 만들어 준다.
